lessons.title: Essential Greetings
lessons.description: Learn the most common everyday greetings in Indian Sign Language.

signs.description: Raise dominant hand to forehead temple, touch lightly, and extend outward in a smooth waving motion.
Touch fingers of flat hand to chin or lips, then extend palm forward towards the other person.
Place flat open hand over chest and rub in gentle circular clockwise motions.
Sign 'Good' from chin to flat palm, then raise dominant hand up to mimic the rising sun.
Point fingers inward toward chest then rotate outward with questioning open palms.

lessons.title: ASL Starter Signs
lessons.description: Everyday greetings and polite expressions in American Sign Language.

signs.description: Open B-hand at temple saluting forward with a welcoming gesture.
Touch fingertips to chin and move forward towards the other person.
Make an S-fist and nod the wrist up and down twice like a nodding head.
Snap index finger and middle finger down against thumb rapidly.
Point index finger directly forward toward the conversational partner.
